1.w: A Maskil of Asaph. Give ear, O my people, [to] my instruction; stretch out your⁺ ear to the words of my mouth.

2.w: I will open my mouth in a parable; I will pour forth things hidden from of old,

3.w: which we have heard and known, and our fathers have recounted to us.

4.w: We will not hide [them] from their children, recounting to a following generation: The praises of YHWH, and His strength, and His wonders that He has done.

5.w: For He established a testimony in Jacob, and a law He has appointed in Israel, which He commanded [to] our fathers, to make them known to their sons,

6.w: so that a following generation would know them—the sons to be born—to arise and recount to their sons,

7.w: that they should put their hope in God, and not forget the works of God, and keep His commandments.

8.w: And they should not be like their fathers—a generation being stubborn and rebellious, a generation [that] did not set firm its heart, and [whose] spirit was not faithful to God.

9.w: The sons of Ephraim, handling [and] shooting the bow, turned back on the day of battle.

10.w: They did not keep the covenant of God, and in His law they refused to walk,

11.w: and they forgot His deeds, and His wonders that He had shown them.

12.w: In the eyes of their fathers He did a wonder, in the land of Egypt, [in] the field of Zoan.

13.w: He divided the sea and let them cross over, and the waters He made stand up like a heap.

14.w: And He led them with the cloud by day, and all the night with a light of fire.

15.w: He split open the rocks in the wilderness, and gave to drink, like the depths [in] abundance.

16.w: And He brought forth streams from the rock, and made waters come down like the rivers.

17.w: And they added still to sin against Him by rebelling against the Most High in the desert.

18.w: And they tested God in their heart, by requesting food of their soul.

19.w: And they spoke against God, saying, “Is God able to arrange a table in the wilderness?

20.w: Behold, He struck the rock, and the waters gushed out, and torrents overflowed; and also is He able to give bread or provide food for His people?”

21.w: Therefore YHWH heard and boiled over, and a fire was kindled against Jacob, and anger came up against Israel,

22.w: because they did not have faith in God, and they did not trust in His salvation.

23.w: And He commanded the clouds above, and the doors of the heavens He opened.

24.w: And He rained down on them manna to eat—and he gave to them the grain of the heavens.

25.w: The bread of the mighty ones a man ate; food He sent to them in abundance.

26.w: An east wind He caused to blow in the heavens, and He guided by His power the south wind.

27.w: And He rained upon them food like the dust, and winged bird like the sand of the seas,

28.w: and He felled them in the midst of their camp, all around their dwellings.

29.w: So they ate and were satisfied greatly, and their desires He brought to them.

30.w: They were not estranged from their desire, and still their food [was] in their mouth.

31.w: And the anger of God came upon them, and He killed the fattest of them and subdued the young men of Israel.

32.w: In all this, still they sinned, and they did not have faith in His wonders.

33.w: And He finished off their days in futility, and their years in terror.

34.w: When He slew them, they would seek Him, and they turned back and sought after God.

35.w: And they remembered that God [was] their rock, and El-Elyon their Redeemer.

36.w: And they deceived Him with their mouth, and with their tongue they lied to Him.

37.w: And their heart was not established with Him, and they were not faithful to His covenant.

38.w: And He, the compassionate One, forgave the iniquity and did not destroy [them]; and He often restrained His anger, and He did not stir up all His wrath.

39.w: And He remembered that they [were] flesh, a breath going by that does not return.

40.w: How often they rebelled against Him in the wilderness [and] grieved Him in the desert!

41.w: And they turned back and tested God, and they pained the Holy One of Israel.

42.w: They have not remembered His hand, the day when He ransomed them from the adversary,

43.w: when He worked His signs in Egypt, and His wonders in the field of Zoan.

44.w: And He turned their rivers into blood, and from their streams they could not drink.

45.w: He sent among them the swarm, and it consumed them, and the frog, and it destroyed them.

46.w: And He gave to the ravager their produce, and their labor to the locust.

47.w: He destroyed with hail their vines, and their sycamore trees with frost.

48.w: And He gave up to the hail their cattle, and their flocks to the firebolts.

49.w: He sent against them the burning of His anger—fury, and rage, and distress, a discharge of messengers of evils.

50.w: He made level a path for His anger; He did not spare their soul from death, and He gave over their life to the pestilence.

51.w: He even struck all the firstborn in Egypt, the first of the vigour in the tents of Ham.

52.w: And His people He made go forth like sheep, and He guided them like a flock in the wilderness.

53.w: And He led them to safety, and they did not dread, and the sea covered their enemies.

54.w: And He brought them to the border of His holiness, this mountain His right hand had acquired.

55.w: And He drove out the nations before their face, and caused them to fall in the line of inheritance, and the tribes of Israel He settled in their tents.

56.w: And they tested and provoked El-Elyon, and His testimonies they did not keep.

57.w: And they turned back and were treacherous like their fathers; they were turned like a bow of deceit.

58.w: And they provoked Him to anger with their high places, and with their carved images they made Him jealous.

59.w: God heard and boiled over, and exceedingly He rejected Israel;

60.w: and He left behind the dwelling place of Shiloh, the tent He had pitched among men,

61.w: and He delivered His strength to captivity, and His splendor to the hand of the adversary.

62.w: And He delivered up His people to the sword, and on His inheritance He boiled over.

63.w: Fire consumed His young men, and His virgins have not been praised.

64.w: His priests fell by the sword, and the widows could not weep.

65.w: And the Lord awoke as a sleeper, as a mighty one overcome by wine.

66.w: And He beat his adversaries back; a reproach forever He gave to them.

67.w: And He rejected the tent of Joseph, and the tribe of Ephraim He would not choose.

68.w: And He chose the tribe of Judah, Mount Zion, which He loved.

69.w: And He built His sanctuary like the heights; like the earth He founded it forever.

70.w: And He chose David His servant, and He took him from the folds of [his] flock;

71.w: He brought him from tending the ewes to be shepherd of Jacob His people, and of Israel His inheritance.

72.w: And he tended them with the integrity of his heart, and by the skillfulness of his hands he guided them.
